systemic_signals.title: The delta path holds the PLACE and does not hold the FACE
systemic_signals.detail: Three parent/child comparisons available: L28->L29 (place seed), L30->L31 (chain), L33->L34 (chain). Environment, palette, prop positions and foreground crops held in 3 of 3, tightly (1.48% px change on L30->L31, 3.67% on L33->L34, change masks confined to the authored addition plus outline jitter). Figures held in 0 of 3: L31 moved terry-johnson's eyeline and brow colour; L34 re-drew both ibm-suit and miniscribe-rep from scratch. Every face change was unauthored and every one lands across a hard cut between adjacent VO lines. Whatever the delta mechanism pins, it pins scenery and lets the cast float - a fixable seeding asymmetry, not independent accidents.

systemic_signals.title: miniscribe-rep hair is the canary; L33 is the single outlier
systemic_signals.detail: Six frames in the slice carry him. Five draw warm dark-brown side-parted quiff hair matching the canonical (L29, L34, L35, L36, L37). ONLY L33 draws jet-black with a different head outline. So the identity problem is one bad frame, not a drifting cast, and re-minting L33 alone would also close L34's over-cap delta. The terry-johnson case is a different kind: the STEP-1 card (dark brows) and the canonical (pale brows) genuinely disagree, so L30 and L31 each obeyed a different authority - that one needs a SOURCE RULING before any re-mint or the next pass just flips the flicker.

systemic_signals.title: Median saturation sits below the era prior across most of the act
systemic_signals.detail: Nine of twelve frames measure 0.0745-0.1686 against a ~0.19 prior; only L26 (0.1843), L36 (0.1961) and L37 (0.2039) reach it. Every low frame has an explicitly grey or cool palette in its own prompt, so each is individually compliant - but frame-by-frame compliance is producing an act that will read flatter than the era prior taken as a body, and the three frames that do reach the prior are the three that authored a warm or coloured ground. Act-level colour-budget observation, not a per-frame defect; nothing failed on it.

systemic_signals.title: Enumerated counts in prose are not reliably honoured, in either direction
systemic_signals.detail: L26 renders 7 of 9 cartons, undershooting exactly the two clusters the prose doubled and tripled; L36 renders two cropped foreground bales where one was named; L28 renders two bench runs per side where two total were named. No consistent direction - an enumerated multiplicity is being treated as a vague 'several'. Low stakes on these three, but it matters the moment a count is the point of a shot.

systemic_signals.title: NOT systemic - stated explicitly
systemic_signals.detail: Unauthored text appeared in exactly one frame (L32), and lettering was correct on all three frames that seeded the lettering-marker-italic exemplar (L28, its L29 carry, and L36).
